title: 完本感言
content_zh:
去年7月19发书，到今天，刚好10个月，《星门》完本。
其他几本书完本，都是不舍，期待。
星门完本，说实话，只有怅然若失，只有遗憾，只能说一声，力不从心，身心俱疲。
腰疼持续了一年多，从未停歇，疼几天没事，持续不断的疼，耗空了老鹰的精力。
前半年，还能坚持，还能忍受，等过完年之后，彻底扛不住了，持续不断的失眠，精力耗空，彻底维持不住局面了，不得不不断砍副本，砍剧情。
天星王朝九司落幕开始，就开始不断缩减剧情了。
有人说，老鹰为何不少更新一点，为何不缓一缓，请假或者断更，等恢复了再继续……在老鹰看来，既然开了头，思维思绪便是一个故事的开始，中间断掉，再续上，其实整个人便不会再沉浸在这个故事中了，那再捡起来去写，就已经无法代入当时的感受了，那就是另外一个故事了。
当然，遗憾肯定还是有的，不过整体框架老鹰还是尽力维持了完整。
至于结局，化凡归来，在我看来，这是老鹰的真实写照，也是修士的归途，也许有人不喜欢，但是这个结局，其实我还是很喜欢的。
少了一些年轻时候的热血，多了几分平凡，年少的时候，总想出去看看，走一走，闯一闯，等稍大一些，心态自然会出现一些变化，每一位主角，都是作者代入的，不同时期的主角，自然也会有些不同的感受感悟。
当然，热血江湖，是每个人，或者每个男人，到老都不会忘记的，就如最后说的，江湖还在，有人便有江湖。
李皓回归，化凡而回，亲人回归，不代表凡人就没有了辉煌。
平凡而不平庸！
本已走到了混沌之巅，再化凡，也不会是平庸之人，可以活的精彩一些，他们是最后一代武师，最后一代修士，也许也是最后一代江湖豪客，银月英雄榜，也许会变成混沌英雄榜，江湖还在，武林还在，只是少了混沌的冷清，多了一些凡俗的热闹。
邻居是人王，是宇皇，是春秋，是无数见证了这一代传奇的混沌豪侠，我想，接下来的混沌，没了飞天遁地的道，也会有属于自己的江湖豪情。
没有只手灭天地，无数凡俗之人，不会如尘埃死去，也许，会绽放出更灿烂的光彩，当然，这些都是后话了，所以无需担心，凡俗中的李皓，便只能养老等死，人生短暂，才能迸发更璀璨的光辉。
人老了，有些人便糊涂了，多少君王年少时期，英明神武，老了，便糊涂了，所以，活的老，活的长，未必就是好事。
这些故事，后续的故事，银月的故事，三十六雄的故事，人王的故事，宇皇的故事，后续我可能会写番外……只是可能，我这人，一旦完本，往往说写，最后又懒得去写，不打包票，不过若是闲来无事，也会回想一下，回味一下，江湖的精彩。
梦想还是要有的，江湖梦，谁还没有呢？
另外，《星门》完本之后，老鹰要先休养，养好了身体，才能继续写下去了，一直带着病痛，写出来的东西，是很难让人满意的，所以这一次应该会休息一段时间了，我不知道具体多久，也许半年，也许一年，也许两年……再归来，也未必还是今日的老鹰了，那时候，将写作彻底化为爱好，化为兴趣，化为梦想，可能会更好一些。

写还是继续写的，封笔也是不存在的，只是忽悠一下其他作者，让他们放下警惕之心，然后王者归来，一剑一个，全部斩于剑下……这个就不要外泄了，免得他们看到了找我要回他们发给我的封笔红包。
靠着封笔之说，我忽悠了不少红包，大家可别外传。
至于下本书，写什么，我不知道，还没考虑好，也没精力去思考，底蕴耗空，休息的时间，给自己充充电吧。
网文这个行业，推陈出新很快，沉浸在过去的辉煌之中，迟早会落幕的，所以，休息的时间，养好身体的同时，老鹰也要给自己充电了，要不然，就被时代淘汰了。
每个时代，都有每个时代的英雄，每个时代的主角，所以，想成为下个时代的主角，还得闭关潜修，四处交流，到处悟道，要不然，这个时代就要抛弃你了。
从财源开始，到今年，六年多了，写下了3000万字，也算是老鹰这几年来，最大的收获了，当然，还有家庭，还有孩子，还有收获了无数读者的喜欢和支持，再次感谢大家！
此外，再感谢一下各位书友的鼎力支持，一路相随。
下个故事再见，江湖路远，大家珍重。
希望诸位，在各自的领域，绽放精彩，平凡而不平庸，巅峰再见！
7017k
content_en:
The book was released on July 19 last year, and today, exactly 10 months later, "Star Gate" has been completed.
Several other books were finished with reluctance and anticipation.
After finishing the book of Star Gate, to be honest, I can only feel a sense of loss and regret. I can only say that I feel powerless and exhausted both physically and mentally.
The back pain lasted for more than a year and never stopped. The pain was fine for a few days, but the constant pain drained the energy of the eagle.
In the first half of the year, I was still able to persevere and tolerate it. After the New Year, I couldn't bear it anymore. I suffered from constant insomnia and energy consumption. I couldn't maintain the situation at all. I had to keep cutting copies and plots.
Since the end of the Nine Divisions of Tianxing Dynasty, the plot has been continuously reduced.
Some people say, why does the Eagle update a little more, why not slow down, take a leave or stop updating, and then continue after recovering... In the Eagle's view, since it has started, the thoughts are the beginning of a story. If it is interrupted in the middle and resumed, in fact, the whole person will no longer be immersed in the story. Then pick it up and write it, and it will no longer be able to replace the feelings at that time, and it will be another story.
Of course, there must still be regrets, but the Eagles still tried their best to maintain the integrity of the overall framework.
As for the ending, the return from mortal form, in my opinion, this is a true portrayal of the eagle and the return journey of the monk. Some people may not like it, but I actually like this ending.
It is less passionate than when I was young and more ordinary. When I was young, I always wanted to go out and see, walk, and venture out. When I get a little older, my mentality will naturally change. Every protagonist is represented by the author. Protagonists in different periods will naturally have different feelings and perceptions.
Of course, the passionate rivers and lakes are something that everyone, or every man, will never forget when they grow old. As I said in the end, if the rivers and lakes are still there, there will be rivers and lakes if there are people.
The return of Li Hao, the return of mortals, and the return of his relatives does not mean that mortals will lose their glory.
Ordinary but not mediocre!
Having reached the peak of chaos, they will not be mediocre people again, but can live a more exciting life. They are the last generation of martial arts masters, the last generation of monks, and perhaps the last generation of rivers and lakes tycoons. The Silver Moon Heroes List may become the Chaos Heroes List. The rivers and lakes are still there, and the martial arts is still there, but there is less of the desertedness of chaos and more of the mundane excitement.
My neighbor is the King of Humans, the Emperor of the Universe, the Spring and Autumn Period, and the countless heroes of Chaos who have witnessed the legends of this generation. I think that the following Chaos, without the way to fly to the sky and escape from the earth, will also have its own heroic spirit.
There is no single hand that can destroy the world. Countless ordinary people will not die like dust. Perhaps, they will bloom with more brilliant brilliance. Of course, these are all things for later, so there is no need to worry. In the ordinary world, Li Hao can only wait for death. Life is short, so that he can shine more brilliantly.
When people get old, some people become confused. Many kings were wise and powerful when they were young, but they become confused when they get old. Therefore, living old and living long is not necessarily a good thing.
These stories, the follow-up stories, the story of Silver Moon, the story of Thirty-Six Heroes, the story of the Human King, the story of Yuhuang, I may write extras in the follow-up... It's just possible that once I finish the book, I often talk about writing, but in the end I am too lazy to write it. I don't guarantee it, but if I have nothing to do, I will think about it and reminisce about the excitement of the world.
You still have to have dreams. Who doesn’t have the dream of being in the world of martial arts?
In addition, after finishing "Star Gate", Eagle needs to rest and recover before he can continue writing. He has been suffering from illness, and the things he writes are difficult to satisfy, so he will take a break this time. I don't know how long, maybe half a year, maybe a year, maybe two years... When he comes back, he may not be the same Eagle he is today. At that time, it may be better to completely turn writing into a hobby, an interest, and a dream.
I should continue to write,There is no such thing as sealing. I just want to fool other authors and let them lower their guard. Then the king returns and kills them all with one sword... Don't let this out, lest they see it and ask me to get back the sealing red envelope they sent me.
I cheated a lot of red envelopes by relying on my words, so please don’t spread the word.
As for the next book, I don’t know what to write. I haven’t thought about it yet, and I don’t have the energy to think about it. My foundation is exhausted. I should recharge myself during the rest time.
The online writing industry is very fast in innovating, and immersed in the glory of the past will come to an end sooner or later. Therefore, while taking a rest and taking good care of your body, you must also recharge your batteries, otherwise you will be eliminated by the times.
Every era has heroes and protagonists of every era. Therefore, if you want to be the protagonist of the next era, you must practice in seclusion, communicate everywhere, and gain enlightenment everywhere. Otherwise, this era will abandon you.
From the beginning of financial resources, to this year, more than six years later, I have written 30 million words, which can be regarded as the biggest gain of Eagle in the past few years. Of course, there are also families and children, and I have gained the love and support of countless readers. Thank you again!
In addition, I would like to thank all the book friends for their strong support and accompanying me all the way.
See you in the next story. There is a long way to go, so please take it seriously.
I hope you will flourish in your respective fields and be ordinary but not mediocre. See you at the top!
